description: Engine setup of map5_s00 (Sewers - lower and upper levels), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type DR, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: HangedScratcher and Creeper). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: script (slots drawn by effect_slot_draw of this map's world_objects.lua). A mod changes it with its own maps/map5_s00/overlay.json.
